stations.title: The API
stations.text: Reads workshops, but never takes new ones.

captions: At the front desk, Sunniva wants to add a Friday workshop without a code change.
The API can read workshops, but nothing takes a new one from a request.
You read the JSON body, check every field and save only what passes.
Throwing bowls is saved with its own id, and a bad form gets a list of what to fix.
New workshops come from the desk now, and nonsense never reaches the store.
